      <ix:continuation id="Text_06b9a666d6dc4469966604c188f7df0c12" continuedAt="Text_06b9a666d6dc4469966604c188f7df0c13"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59342" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59343">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We amortize premiums and discounts on debt securities over the life of the security as an adjustment to yield using the effective interest method. We compute investment
        gains and losses using the specific identification method.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_06b9a666d6dc4469966604c188f7df0c13" continuedAt="Text_06b9a666d6dc4469966604c188f7df0c14"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59343" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59344">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_06b9a666d6dc4469966604c188f7df0c14"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59344" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59345">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We amortize premiums and discounts for mortgage-backed debt securities using anticipated prepayments.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59345" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59346">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:FairValueOfFinancialInstrumentsPolicy" id="Text_3106e642cde3450db8aff1d8b8479f4c" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808961"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59346" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59347">
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Fair Values of Financial Instruments</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808961" continuedAt="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808962"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59347" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59348">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808962" continuedAt="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808963"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59348" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59349">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We use the following methods and assumptions in estimating our fair value disclosures:</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808963" continuedAt="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808964"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59349" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59350">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808964" continuedAt="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808965"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59350" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59351">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Investments - We present our investments in available-for-sale fixed maturity and equity securities at estimated fair value. The estimated fair value of a security may
        differ from the amount that we could realize if we sold the security in a forced transaction. In addition, the valuation of fixed maturity investments is more subjective when markets are less liquid, increasing the potential that the estimated fair
        value does not reflect the price at which an actual transaction would occur. We utilize nationally recognized independent pricing services to estimate fair values for our fixed maturity and equity investments. We generally obtain two prices per
        security. The pricing services utilize market quotations for fixed maturity and equity securities that have quoted prices in active markets. For fixed maturity securities that generally do not trade on a daily basis, the pricing services prepare
        estimates of fair value measurements based predominantly on observable market inputs. The pricing services do not use broker quotes in determining the fair values of our investments. Our investment personnel review the estimates of fair value the
        pricing services provide to determine if the estimates we obtain are representative of fair values based upon the general knowledge of our investment personnel of the market, their research findings related to unusual fluctuations in value and
        their comparison of such values to execution prices for similar securities. Our investment personnel monitor the market and are familiar with current trading ranges for similar securities and the pricing of specific investments. Our investment
        personnel review all pricing estimates that we receive from the pricing services against their expectations with respect to pricing based on fair market curves, security ratings, coupon rates, security type and recent trading activity.  Our
        investment personnel review documentation with respect to the pricing services’ pricing methodology that they obtain periodically to determine if the primary pricing sources, market inputs and pricing frequency for various security types are
        reasonable. We refer to Note 5 - Fair Value Measurements for more information regarding our methods and assumptions in estimating fair values.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808965" continuedAt="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808966"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59351" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59352">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808966" continuedAt="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808967"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59352" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59353">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Cash and Short-Term Investments - The carrying amounts we report in the balance sheet for these instruments approximate their fair values.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808967" continuedAt="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808968"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59353" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59354">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_8b55c306b5704907b1db9842263808968"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59354" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59355">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Premiums and Reinsurance Receivables and Payables - The carrying amounts we report in the balance sheet for these instruments related to premiums and paid losses and
        loss expenses approximate their fair values.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59355" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59356">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:RevenueRecognitionPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_3c0640fe973541db9b02bbc2222d73c1" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_05ce9f1bde454799a959a4e055658a8f1"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59356" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59357">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: -36pt; margin-left: 36pt; font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Revenue Recognition</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_05ce9f1bde454799a959a4e055658a8f1" continuedAt="Text_05ce9f1bde454799a959a4e055658a8f2"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59357" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59358">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_05ce9f1bde454799a959a4e055658a8f2"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59358" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59359">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Our insurance subsidiaries recognize insurance premiums as income over the terms of the policies they issue. Our insurance subsidiaries calculate unearned premiums on a
        daily pro-rata basis. </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59359" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59360">
<div><br/></div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:CapitalizationOfDeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostsPolicy" id="Text_f15100cab9364b73badb834a76c482f7" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_e53c723b2040471cb5603df918c8a7371"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59360" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59361">
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Policy Acquisition Costs</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e53c723b2040471cb5603df918c8a7371" continuedAt="Text_e53c723b2040471cb5603df918c8a7372"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59361" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59362">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e53c723b2040471cb5603df918c8a7372"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59362" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59363">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We defer our insurance subsidiaries’ policy acquisition costs, consisting primarily of commissions, premium taxes and certain other underwriting costs, reduced by ceding
        commissions, related directly to the successful acquisition of new or renewal insurance contracts. We amortize these deferred policy acquisition costs over the period in which our insurance subsidiaries earn the premiums. The method we follow in
        computing deferred policy acquisition costs limits the amount of such deferred costs to their estimated realizable value, which gives effect to the premium to be earned, related investment income, losses and loss expenses and certain other costs we
        expect to incur as our insurance subsidiaries earn the premium. Estimates in the calculation of policy acquisition costs have not shown material variability because of uncertainties in applying accounting principles or as a result of sensitivities
        to changes in key assumptions.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59363" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59364">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59364" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59365"><ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_cbbde9a607364b66bf666bf258c3fdcc" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_fc1b78c719b74f56997f9780c098fedf1">
<div><span style="font-weight: bold;"><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: bold; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Property and Equipment</span> </span></div>
</ix:nonNumeric></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59365" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59366"><ix:continuation id="Text_fc1b78c719b74f56997f9780c098fedf1" continuedAt="Text_fc1b78c719b74f56997f9780c098fedf2">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59366" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59367"><ix:continuation id="Text_fc1b78c719b74f56997f9780c098fedf2">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We report property and equipment at depreciated cost that we compute using the straight-line method based upon estimated useful lives of the assets.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59367" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59368">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:LiabilityReserveEstimatePolicy" id="Text_758cb07cdaa94ed9b4130a5cb775f033" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd1"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59368" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59369">
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Losses and Loss Expenses</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd1" continuedAt="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd2"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59369" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59370">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd2" continuedAt="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd3"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59370" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59371">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 24.75pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Liabilities for losses and loss expenses are estimates at a given point in time of the amounts an insurer expects to pay with respect to incurred policyholder claims
        based on facts and circumstances the insurer knows at that point in time. For example, legislative, judicial and regulatory actions may expand coverage definitions, retroactively mandate coverage or otherwise require our insurance subsidiaries to
        pay losses for damages that their policies explicitly excluded or did not intend to cover. At the time of establishing its estimates, an insurer recognizes that its ultimate liability for losses and loss expenses will exceed or be less than such
        estimates. Our insurance subsidiaries base their estimates of liabilities for losses and loss expenses on assumptions as to future loss trends, expected claims severity, judicial theories of liability and other factors. However, during the loss
        adjustment period, our insurance subsidiaries may learn additional facts regarding individual claims, and, consequently, it often becomes necessary for our insurance subsidiaries to refine and adjust their estimates for these liabilities. We
        reflect any adjustments to the liabilities for losses and loss expenses of our insurance subsidiaries in our consolidated results of operations in the period in which our insurance subsidiaries make adjustments to their estimates.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd3" continuedAt="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd4"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59371" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59372">
<div><br/></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd4" continuedAt="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd5"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59372" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59373">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 24.75pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">O<span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-weight: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 33px; text-transform: none; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">ur insurance subsidiaries
          maintain liabilities for the payment of losses and loss expenses with respect to both reported and unreported claims. Our insurance subsidiaries establish these liabilities for the purpose of covering the ultimate costs of settling all losses,
          including investigation and litigation costs. Our insurance subsidiaries base the amount of their liability for reported losses primarily upon a case-by-case evaluation of the type of risk involved, knowledge of the circumstances surrounding each
          claim and the insurance policy provisions relating to the type of loss the policyholder incurred. Our insurance subsidiaries determine the amount of their liability for unreported claims and loss expenses on the basis of historical information by
          line of insurance. Our insurance subsidiaries account for inflation in the reserving function through analysis of costs and trends and reviews of historical reserving results. Our insurance subsidiaries monitor their liabilities closely and
          recompute them periodically using new information on reported claims and a variety of statistical techniques. Our insurance subsidiaries do not discount their liabilities for losses and loss expenses</span>.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd5" continuedAt="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd6"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59373" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59374">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <div class="BRPFPageBreakArea" style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;">
        <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 8pt; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">-70-</span></div>

        <div class="BRPFPageBreak" style="page-break-after: always;">
          <hr style="border-width: 0px; clear: both; margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000;"/></div>

        <div style="width: 100%;" class="BRPFPageHeader">
          <div><a href="#INDEX"><span style="font-weight: normal; font-style: italic; font-size: 8pt;">Index</span></a></div>

        </div>

      </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd6" continuedAt="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd7"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59374" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59375">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-indent: 24px; white-space: normal; word-spacing: 0px; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">Reserve estimates can change over time because of unexpected changes in
          assumptions related to our insurance subsidiaries’ external environment and, to a lesser extent, assumptions related to our insurance subsidiaries’ internal operations. For example, our insurance subsidiaries have experienced an increase in
          claims severity and a lengthening of the claim settlement periods on bodily injury claims during the past several years. In addition, the COVID-19 pandemic and related government mandates and restrictions resulted in various changes from
          historical claims reporting and settlement trends during 2020 and resulted in significant increases in loss costs in subsequent years due to a number of factors, including supply chain disruption, higher new and used automobile values, increases
          in the cost of replacement automobile parts and rising labor rates. These continuing trend changes caused significant disruption to historical loss patterns and give rise to greater uncertainty as to the pattern of future loss settlements.
          Related uncertainties regarding future trends include social inflation, availability and cost of replacement automobile parts and building materials, availability and cost of skilled labor, the rate of specialized plaintiff attorney involvement
          in claims, plaintiff attorney utilization of litigation financing and the cost of medical technologies and procedures. Assumptions related to our insurance subsidiaries’ external environment include the absence of significant changes in tort law
          and the legal environment that increase liability exposure, consistency in judicial interpretations of insurance coverage and policy provisions and the rate of loss cost inflation. Internal assumptions include consistency in the recording of
          premium and loss statistics, consistency in the recording of claims, payment and case reserving methodology, accurate measurement of the impact of rate changes and changes in policy provisions, consistency in the quality and characteristics of
          business written within a given line of business and consistency in reinsurance coverage and collectability of reinsured losses, among other items. To the extent our insurance subsidiaries determine that underlying factors impacting their
          assumptions have changed, our insurance subsidiaries make adjustments in their reserves that they consider appropriate for such changes. Accordingly, our insurance subsidiaries’ ultimate liability for unpaid losses and loss expenses will likely
          differ from the amount recorded at December 31, 2024.</span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd7" continuedAt="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd8"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59375" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59376">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_df8a4764fa0244a490cc62096cf187dd8"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59376" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59377">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Our insurance subsidiaries seek to enhance their underwriting results by carefully selecting the product lines they underwrite. Our insurance subsidiaries’ personal
        lines products primarily include standard and preferred risks in private passenger automobile and homeowners lines. Our insurance subsidiaries’ commercial lines products primarily include business offices, wholesalers, service providers,
        contractors, artisans and light manufacturing operations. Our insurance subsidiaries have limited exposure to asbestos and other environmental liabilities.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59377" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59378">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_e214152398164bf8bd1571530abdc996" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_1de6be8dd1174e28b3d48a193ad527a41"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59378" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59379">
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Income Taxes</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_1de6be8dd1174e28b3d48a193ad527a41" continuedAt="Text_1de6be8dd1174e28b3d48a193ad527a42"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59379" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59380">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_1de6be8dd1174e28b3d48a193ad527a42" continuedAt="Text_1de6be8dd1174e28b3d48a193ad527a43"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59380" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59381">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We currently file a consolidated federal income tax return that includes us and our insurance subsidiaries.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_1de6be8dd1174e28b3d48a193ad527a43" continuedAt="Text_1de6be8dd1174e28b3d48a193ad527a44"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59381" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59382">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_1de6be8dd1174e28b3d48a193ad527a44"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59382" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59383">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We account for income taxes using the asset and liability method. The objective of the asset and liability method is to establish deferred tax assets and liabilities for
        the temporary differences between the financial reporting basis and the tax basis of our assets and liabilities at enacted tax rates we expect to be in effect when we realize or settle such amounts.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59383" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59384">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:ConcentrationRiskCreditRisk" id="Text_79fad635ff80455c80564fef625b8ef6" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_7df6fffdcb864fa8b9b7317b434904cb1"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59384" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59385">
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Credit Risk</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7df6fffdcb864fa8b9b7317b434904cb1" continuedAt="Text_7df6fffdcb864fa8b9b7317b434904cb2"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59385" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59386">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7df6fffdcb864fa8b9b7317b434904cb2" continuedAt="Text_7df6fffdcb864fa8b9b7317b434904cb3"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59386" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59387">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Our objective is to earn competitive returns by investing in a diversified portfolio of securities. Our portfolio of fixed maturity securities and, to a lesser extent,
        short-term investments is subject to credit risk. We define this risk as the potential loss in fair value resulting from adverse changes in the borrower’s ability to repay its debt to us. We manage this risk by performing an analysis of prospective
        investments and through regular reviews of our portfolio by our investment personnel. We also limit the amount of our total investment portfolio that we invest in any one security.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7df6fffdcb864fa8b9b7317b434904cb3" continuedAt="Text_7df6fffdcb864fa8b9b7317b434904cb4"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59387" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59388">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7df6fffdcb864fa8b9b7317b434904cb4" continuedAt="Text_7df6fffdcb864fa8b9b7317b434904cb5"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59388" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59389">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Our insurance subsidiaries provide property and liability insurance coverages through independent insurance agencies located throughout their operating areas. Our
        insurance subsidiaries bill the majority of this business directly to their policyholders, although our insurance subsidiaries bill a portion of their commercial business through their agents, to whom they extend credit in the normal course of
        business.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7df6fffdcb864fa8b9b7317b434904cb5" continuedAt="Text_7df6fffdcb864fa8b9b7317b434904cb6"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59389" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59390">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7df6fffdcb864fa8b9b7317b434904cb6"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59390" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59391">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Our insurance subsidiaries have reinsurance agreements with Donegal Mutual and with a number of major unaffiliated reinsurers.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59391" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59392">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:ReinsuranceAccountingPolicy" id="Text_974e478338784ca08e52c3684616c2fe" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_1634645cfe1040c6b70c4bfbd132446a1"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59392" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59393">
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Reinsurance Accounting and Reporting</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_1634645cfe1040c6b70c4bfbd132446a1" continuedAt="Text_1634645cfe1040c6b70c4bfbd132446a2"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59393" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59394">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_1634645cfe1040c6b70c4bfbd132446a2" continuedAt="Text_1634645cfe1040c6b70c4bfbd132446a3"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59394" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59395">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 18pt;">Our insurance subsidiaries rely upon reinsurance agreements to limit their maximum net loss from large single risks or risks in concentrated areas and to increase their
        capacity to write insurance. Reinsurance does not relieve our insurance subsidiaries from liability to their respective policyholders. To the extent that a reinsurer cannot pay losses for which it is liable under the terms of a reinsurance
        agreement with one or more of our insurance subsidiaries, our insurance subsidiaries retain continued liability for such losses. However, in an effort to reduce the risk of non-payment, our insurance subsidiaries require all of their reinsurers to
        have an A.M. Best rating of A- or better or, with respect to foreign reinsurers, to have a financial condition that, in the opinion of our management, is equivalent to a company with an A.M. Best rating of A- or better. We refer to Note 10 -
        Reinsurance for more information regarding the reinsurance agreements of our insurance subsidiaries.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_1634645cfe1040c6b70c4bfbd132446a3" continuedAt="Text_1634645cfe1040c6b70c4bfbd132446a4"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59395" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59396">
<div><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation></div>

    <div><ix:continuation id="Text_1634645cfe1040c6b70c4bfbd132446a4" continuedAt="Text_1634645cfe1040c6b70c4bfbd132446a5"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59396" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59397">
<div><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 13.3333px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; text-transform: none; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;"><br/>
      </span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <div class="BRPFPageBreakArea" style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;">
        <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 8pt; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">-71-</span></div>

        <div class="BRPFPageBreak" style="page-break-after: always;">
          <hr style="border-width: 0px; clear: both; margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000;"/></div>

        <div style="width: 100%;" class="BRPFPageHeader">
          <div><a href="#INDEX"><span style="font-weight: normal; font-style: italic; font-size: 8pt;">Index</span></a></div>

        </div>

      </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_1634645cfe1040c6b70c4bfbd132446a5"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59397" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59398">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-indent: 18pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"><span style="font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; word-spacing: 0px; white-space: normal; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; display: inline ! important; float: none;">We report reinsurance receivable net of an allowance for expected credit losses. We establish an allowance for expected credit losses based upon our ongoing review of amounts outstanding, historical loss data, changes in reinsurer
          credit standing and other relevant factors. We utilize a probability-of-default methodology, which reflects current and forecasted economic conditions, to estimate the allowance for expected credit losses and recognize changes to the allowance in
          our results of operations.</span></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59398" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59399">
<div><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> </span>
      <span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd59399" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593100">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:CompensationRelatedCostsPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_c832a2e14693492d99e14acd3f52fa04" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_858b5f8deb774c3f82fb17c1b841a1211"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593100" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593101">
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Stock-Based Compensation</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_858b5f8deb774c3f82fb17c1b841a1211" continuedAt="Text_858b5f8deb774c3f82fb17c1b841a1212"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593101" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593102">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_858b5f8deb774c3f82fb17c1b841a1212" continuedAt="Text_858b5f8deb774c3f82fb17c1b841a1213"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593102" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593103">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We measure all share-based payments to our directors and the directors and employees of our subsidiaries and affiliates, including grants of stock options, using a
        fair-value-based method and record such expense in our results of operations. In determining the expense we record for stock options we grant to our directors and the directors and employees of our subsidiaries and affiliates, we estimate the fair
        value of each option award on the date of grant using the Black-Scholes option pricing model. The significant assumptions we utilize in applying the Black-Scholes option pricing model are the risk-free interest rate, expected term, dividend yield
        and expected volatility.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_858b5f8deb774c3f82fb17c1b841a1213" continuedAt="Text_858b5f8deb774c3f82fb17c1b841a1214"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593103" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593104">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_858b5f8deb774c3f82fb17c1b841a1214"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593104" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593105">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In 2024, 2023 and 2022, we realized $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationTaxBenefitFromExerciseOfStockOptions" id="Fact_30c2b8067f45449aa9728a32f4a8ab6a" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U001" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">370,644</ix:nonFraction>, $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationTaxBenefitFromExerciseOfStockOptions" id="Fact_83612a1468024bb688ca93c57103915d" contextRef="c20230101to20231231" unitRef="U001" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">139,135</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationTaxBenefitFromExerciseOfStockOptions" id="Fact_8f62b805c21043dbb9efe657050c7461" contextRef="c20220101to20221231" unitRef="U001" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">360,452</ix:nonFraction>, respectively, in
        tax benefits upon the exercise of stock options.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593105" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593106">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:EarningsPerSharePolicyTextBlock" id="Text_010c03d5539d44e284b5bec9b232b3ba" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_70c7009e3c81433ab7911ad6e6e0453a1"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593106" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593107">
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Earnings Per Share</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_70c7009e3c81433ab7911ad6e6e0453a1" continuedAt="Text_70c7009e3c81433ab7911ad6e6e0453a2"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593107" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593108">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_70c7009e3c81433ab7911ad6e6e0453a2" continuedAt="Text_70c7009e3c81433ab7911ad6e6e0453a3"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593108" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593109">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We calculate basic earnings per share by dividing net income by the weighted-average number of common shares outstanding for the period. Diluted earnings per share
        reflects the dilution that could occur if securities or other contracts to issue common stock were exercised or converted into common stock.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_70c7009e3c81433ab7911ad6e6e0453a3" continuedAt="Text_70c7009e3c81433ab7911ad6e6e0453a4"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593109" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593110">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_70c7009e3c81433ab7911ad6e6e0453a4"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593110" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593111">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We have two classes of common stock, which we refer to as Class A common stock and Class B common stock. Our Class A common stock is entitled to the declaration and
        payment of cash dividends that are at least <ix:nonFraction name="dgica:MinimumPercentageOfExcessClassACommonStockDividendOverClassBDividend" id="Fact_28b3e9203d1f42da8f6a54965a52f7b8" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" unitRef="U005" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">10</ix:nonFraction>% higher than those we declare and pay on our Class B common stock. Accordingly, we use
        the two-class method for the computation of earnings per common share. The two-class method is an earnings allocation formula that determines earnings per share separately for each class of common stock based on dividends declared and an allocation
        of remaining undistributed earnings using a participation percentage that reflects the dividend rights of each class.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593111" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593112">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetsPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_2e86858cc5824af382f3e1222770cdd0" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_5fbb51d8800a411bb22fa79c9b6048351"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593112" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593113">
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Goodwill and Other Intangible Assets</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_5fbb51d8800a411bb22fa79c9b6048351" continuedAt="Text_5fbb51d8800a411bb22fa79c9b6048352"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593113" continuedAt="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593114">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_5fbb51d8800a411bb22fa79c9b6048352"><ix:continuation id="Text_0de36092e54e47c0b5a52df4289dd593114">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Goodwill represents the excess of the purchase price over the underlying fair value of acquired entities. When completing acquisitions, we seek also to identify
        separately identifiable intangible assets that we have acquired. We assess goodwill and intangible assets with an indefinite useful life for impairment annually. We also assess goodwill and other intangible assets for impairment upon the occurrence
        of certain events. In making our assessment, we consider a number of factors including operating results, business plans, economic projections, anticipated future cash flows and current market data. Inherent uncertainties exist with respect to
        these factors and to our judgment in applying them when we make our assessment. Impairment of goodwill and other intangible assets could result from changes in economic and operating conditions in future periods.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

      <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>

    </div>

  </div>


  <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left; color: #000000;"> <div><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"> </span></div>

    <div>
      <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:NewAccountingPronouncementsAndChangesInAccountingPrinciplesTextBlock" id="Text_393edf36f6e54f13919687571e1b6c3e" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea71">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">2 - Impact of New Accounting Standards</span></div>
</ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea71" continuedAt="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea72">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman';"><br/>
        </span> </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">
        <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock" id="Text_57c15de2069e426daa67c1c1c4a9609b" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_a373a4d373474360a9bc78b762d0d1391"><ix:continuation id="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea72" continuedAt="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea73">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In September 2016, the Financial Accounting Standards Board (the “FASB”) issued guidance that amended previous guidance on the impairment of financial instruments by
          adding an impairment model that requires an entity to recognize expected credit losses as an allowance rather than impairments as credit losses are incurred. The intent of this guidance is to reduce complexity and result in a more timely
          recognition of expected credit losses. In November 2019, the FASB issued guidance that delayed the effective date for “smaller reporting companies,” as defined in Item 10(f)(1) of Regulation S-K, to annual and interim reporting periods beginning
          after December 15, 2022 from December 15, 2019. We were a smaller reporting company at the time this guidance was issued, and our adoption of this guidance on January 1, 2023 resulted in an after-tax decrease in retained earnings of $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxEffectsAllocatedDirectlyToEquityCumulativeEffectOfChangeInAccountingPrinciple" id="Fact_77433ef48e04493da3ad7200dac0e7d7" contextRef="c20191215to20221215" unitRef="U001" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">1.9</ix:nonFraction> million. The adoption of this guidance did not have a significant impact on our results of operations or cash flows.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>

        <ix:continuation id="Text_a373a4d373474360a9bc78b762d0d1392" continuedAt="Text_a373a4d373474360a9bc78b762d0d1393"><ix:continuation id="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea74" continuedAt="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea75">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In November 2023, the FASB issued guidance that amended previous guidance on the disclosure of reportable segments. The guidance requires disclosure of incremental
          segment information including the title and position of the individual identified as the chief operating decision maker, a narrative explanation of how the chief operating decision maker uses each reported measure of a segment’s profit or loss in
          assessing performance and determining how to allocate resources, as well as quantification of significant segment expenses and other items. We refer to Note 19 - Segment Information for further information and disclosure of items required within
          the amended and enhanced guidance. The adoption of this guidance did not have an impact on our financial position, results of operations or cash flows.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_a373a4d373474360a9bc78b762d0d1393" continuedAt="Text_a373a4d373474360a9bc78b762d0d1394"><ix:continuation id="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea75" continuedAt="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea76">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_a373a4d373474360a9bc78b762d0d1394" continuedAt="Text_a373a4d373474360a9bc78b762d0d1395"><ix:continuation id="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea76" continuedAt="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea77">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In December 2023, the FASB issued guidance to enhance the transparency and usefulness of income tax disclosures. The guidance requires disclosure of specific
          categories in the rate reconciliation table and additional information for reconciling items that meet a quantitative threshold of equal to or greater than 5 percent of the amount computed by multiplying pretax income or loss by the applicable
          statutory income tax rate. The guidance also requires disaggregated disclosure of the amount of income taxes paid for federal, state and foreign taxes. The guidance is effective for annual periods beginning after December 15, 2024. The adoption
          of this guidance will not have an impact on our financial position, results of operations or cash flows. </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_a373a4d373474360a9bc78b762d0d1395" continuedAt="Text_a373a4d373474360a9bc78b762d0d1396"><ix:continuation id="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea77" continuedAt="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea78">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
        </div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
        <ix:continuation id="Text_a373a4d373474360a9bc78b762d0d1396"><ix:continuation id="Text_f9f01fa7c63041c6ad4de32100515ea78">
<div style="text-align: justify; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">In November 2024, the FASB issued guidance requiring disaggregated disclosure of income statement expenses in the notes to financial statements. The guidance
          requires disclosure of certain expenses, including employee compensation, depreciation and selling expenses. The guidance will not impact current income statement expense captions that industry-specific guidance requires. The guidance is
          effective for annual reporting periods beginning after December 15, 2026. The adoption of this guidance will not have an impact on our financial position, results of operations or cash flows.</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>

<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">3 - Transactions with Affiliates</div>
</ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16061" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16062">

      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16062" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16063">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Our insurance subsidiaries conduct business and have various agreements with Donegal Mutual that we describe in the following subparagraphs:</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16063" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16064">

      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16064" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16065">
<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">a. Reinsurance Pooling and Other Reinsurance Arrangements</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16065" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16066">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16066" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16067">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Atlantic States, our largest insurance subsidiary, and Donegal Mutual have a pooling agreement under which both companies contribute substantially all of their direct
        written business to the pool and receive an allocated percentage of the pooled underwriting results, excluding certain reinsurance Donegal Mutual assumes from our insurance subsidiaries. In addition, Donegal Mutual has <ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PremiumsPercentageAssumedToNet" id="Fact_0c1e3654d5cd49e38b8122f18fc4d336" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis_DonegalMutualInsuranceCompanyMember" unitRef="U005" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">100</ix:nonFraction>% quota-share reinsurance agreements with Southern Mutual and the Mountain States insurance subsidiaries, and Donegal Mutual places the business of
        Southern Mutual and the Mountain States insurance subsidiaries into the underwriting pool. Atlantic States has an <ix:nonFraction name="dgica:PercentageOfShareInResultsOfPooledBusinessSubsidiary" id="Fact_631707cef3c44426bd905ed1e21a93a3" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_LegalEntityAxis_AtlanticStatesMember" unitRef="U005" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">80</ix:nonFraction>% share of the
        results of the pool, and Donegal Mutual has a <ix:nonFraction name="dgica:PercentageOfShareInResultsOfPooledBusinessOwnedByThirdParty" id="Fact_72a0fd87675e4b6ab3f7985ac7e52074" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis_DonegalMutualInsuranceCompanyMember" unitRef="U005" decimals="2" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">20</ix:nonFraction>% share of the results of the pool. The intent of the pooling agreement is to produce
        more uniform and stable underwriting results from year to year for each pool participant than they would experience individually and to spread the risk of loss between the participants based on each participant’s relative amount of surplus and
        relative access to capital. Each participant in the pool has at its disposal the capacity of the entire pool, rather than being limited to policy exposures of a size commensurate with its own capital and surplus.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16067" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b16068">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">b. Expense Sharing</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160637" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160638">

      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160638" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160639">
<div><span style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;"> </span></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160639" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160640">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">Donegal Mutual provides
        facilities, management and other services to us and our insurance subsidiaries. In addition, Donegal Mutual purchases and maintains the information technology systems that support the business of Donegal Mutual and our insurance subsidiaries.
        Donegal Mutual allocates certain related expenses to Atlantic States in relation to the relative participation of Atlantic States and Donegal Mutual in the pooling agreement. Our insurance subsidiaries other than Atlantic States reimburse Donegal
        Mutual for allocated costs of services Donegal Mutual provides on their behalf based on their proportion of the total direct premiums written of the Donegal Insurance Group and other metrics. Donegal Mutual allocates costs related to its
        development and maintenance of information technology systems over the estimated useful life of those systems (generally five years) and charges a proportionate share of those costs to our insurance subsidiaries based on their percentage of the
        total net premiums written of the Donegal Insurance Group. Allocated expenses from Donegal Mutual for services it provided to our insurance subsidiaries totaled $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:InsuranceCommissions" id="Fact_57d6e18045b6491ebc181c60e9f2633a" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis_DonegalMutualInsuranceCompanyMember" unitRef="U001" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">224,565,390</ix:nonFraction>, $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:InsuranceCommissions" id="Fact_bd9b97600e4c43e682929b5ee6171aa1" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis_DonegalMutualInsuranceCompanyMember" unitRef="U001" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">218,974,132</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:InsuranceCommissions" id="Fact_8e817be5116b48ba83fc92d4a7b4ae5a" contextRef="c20220101to20221231_ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis_DonegalMutualInsuranceCompanyMember" unitRef="U001" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">199,177,393</ix:nonFraction> for 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively.<br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160640" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160641">
<div><br/></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160641" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160642">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Donegal Mutual is currently in the midst of a multi-year effort to modernize certain of its key technology infrastructure and application systems. Donegal Mutual placed
        several releases of new systems into service beginning in 2020. Donegal Mutual allocated $<ix:nonFraction name="dgica:InfrastructureRelatedCostsAllocatedToInsuranceSubsidiaries" id="Fact_087838b94bad4b2eb4bea62482b81cb9" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis_DonegalMutualInsuranceCompanyMember" unitRef="U001" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">12.3</ix:nonFraction> million, $<ix:nonFraction name="dgica:InfrastructureRelatedCostsAllocatedToInsuranceSubsidiaries" id="Fact_3c6916f8efa74fe8a6803854fe38d229" contextRef="c20230101to20231231_ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis_DonegalMutualInsuranceCompanyMember" unitRef="U001" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">10.5</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction name="dgica:InfrastructureRelatedCostsAllocatedToInsuranceSubsidiaries" id="Fact_27749107ccec4cb5b720e86d877b7307" contextRef="c20220101to20221231_ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis_DonegalMutualInsuranceCompanyMember" unitRef="U001" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">7.6</ix:nonFraction> million of related
        costs to our insurance subsidiaries in 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively. Donegal Mutual will allocate to our insurance subsidiaries their proportionate share of the remaining $<ix:nonFraction name="dgica:ProportionateShareOfRemainingInfrastructureCosts" id="Fact_8457317404dd422aaa189ecbe2ce91f1" contextRef="c20240101to20241231_ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis_DonegalMutualInsuranceCompanyMember" unitRef="U001" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">29.4</ix:nonFraction> million of related costs over the next five years. Donegal Mutual incurred an additional $<ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DeferredCostsCurrentAndNoncurrent" id="Fact_17ae14d470664bdd8e0c742496758f84" contextRef="c20241231_ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis_DonegalMutualInsuranceCompanyMember" unitRef="U001" decimals="-5" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal">14.4</ix:nonFraction>
        million of deferred costs related to releases under development that were not yet ready for their intended use at December 31, 2024.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160642" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160643">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> <br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160643" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160644">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">Our management believes that the allocation methods Donegal Mutual utilizes are reasonable. In addition, Donegal Mutual and we maintain a coordinating committee that
        consists of two members of our board of directors, neither of whom is a member of Donegal Mutual’s board of directors, and two members of Donegal Mutual’s board of directors, neither of whom is a member of our board of directors. The purpose of the
        coordinating committee is to maintain a process for an ongoing evaluation of the fairness of the terms of all transactions between Donegal Mutual and our insurance subsidiaries.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160644" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160645">
<div><br/></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160645" continuedAt="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160646">

</ix:continuation>

<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_e49ad1aa186a4aa28adbc8a1e73b160647">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We lease office equipment with terms ranging from <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:LesseeOperatingLeaseTermOfContract" id="Fact_222a88fb23814d12b73516cee0e242f1" contextRef="c20241231_PropertyPlantAndEquipmentByTypeAxis_OfficeEquipmentMember_RangeAxis_MinimumMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear">3</ix:nonNumeric> to <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:LesseeOperatingLeaseTermOfContract" id="Fact_ea6bbce990464b10b1a4be9e6ebf5b9a" contextRef="c20241231_PropertyPlantAndEquipmentByTypeAxis_OfficeEquipmentMember_RangeAxis_MaximumMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear">10</ix:nonNumeric> years to Donegal Mutual under a lease agreement effective January 1, 2020.</div>
</ix:continuation>

        We had <ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsAndHedges" id="Fact_dd902d1fd2cf411e87ddaaca0387a1d1" contextRef="c20231231" unitRef="U001" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsAndHedges" id="Fact_334cc8f941504faaa909be2abcb597f4" contextRef="c20221231" unitRef="U001" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsAndHedges" id="Fact_189cbce6b29442d29669db2c0175fcc2" contextRef="c20241231" unitRef="U001" decimals="0" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen">no</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction> derivative instruments or hedging activities during 2024, 2023 or 2022.</div>

<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">5 - Fair Value Measurements</div>
</ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf711" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf712">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf712" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf713">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We account for financial assets using a framework that establishes a hierarchy that ranks the quality and reliability of inputs, or assumptions, used in the
        determination of fair value, and we classify financial assets and liabilities carried at fair value in one of the following three categories:</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf713" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf714">
<div><br/></div>
</ix:continuation>

<div>
        <table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="width: 100%; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; border-spacing: 0;" class="DSPFListTable">


  <tr style="vertical-align: top;">

    <td style="vertical-align: top; width: 36pt;"><br/>
              </td>

    <td style="vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                <div>Level 1 - quoted prices in active markets for identical assets and liabilities;</div>
              </td>

  </tr>


</table>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf716" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf717">
<div>
        <table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="width: 100%; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; border-spacing: 0;" class="DSPFListTable">


  <tr style="vertical-align: top;">

    <td style="vertical-align: top; width: 36pt;"><br/>
              </td>

    <td style="vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                <div>Level 2 - directly or indirectly observable inputs other than Level 1 quoted prices; and</div>
              </td>

  </tr>


</table>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf717" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf718">

        <table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="width: 100%; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; border-spacing: 0;" class="DSPFListTable">


  <tr style="vertical-align: top;">

    <td style="vertical-align: top; width: 36pt;"><br/>
              </td>

    <td style="vertical-align: top; width: auto;">
                <div>Level 3 - unobservable inputs not corroborated by market data.</div>
              </td>

  </tr>


</table>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf719" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7110">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7110" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7111">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">For investments that have
        quoted market prices in active markets, we use the quoted market price as fair value and include these investments in Level 1 of the fair value hierarchy. We classify publicly traded equity securities as Level 1. When quoted market prices in active
        markets are not available, we base fair values on quoted market prices of comparable instruments or price estimates we obtain from independent pricing services. We classify our fixed maturity investments and non-publicly traded equity securities as
        Level 2. Our fixed maturity investments consist of U.S. Treasury securities and obligations of U.S. government corporations and agencies, obligations of states and political subdivisions, corporate securities and mortgage-backed securities. </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7111" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7112">
<div><br/></div>
</ix:continuation>
        <div style="clear: both; margin-top: 10pt; margin-bottom: 10pt;" class="BRPFPageBreakArea">
          <div style="text-align: center;" class="BRPFPageNumberArea"><span style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 8pt; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal;">-79-</span></div>

          <div style="page-break-after: always;" class="BRPFPageBreak">
            <hr style="border-width: 0px; clear: both; margin: 4px 0px; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"/></div>

          <div style="width: 100%;" class="BRPFPageHeader">

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

      <ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7112" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7113">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"> At December 31, 2024, we received two estimates per security from the pricing services, and we priced substantially all of our Level 1 and Level 2 investments using
        those prices. In our review of the estimates the pricing services provided at December 31, 2024, we did not identify any material discrepancies, and we did not make any adjustments to the estimates the pricing services provided. </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7113" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7114">
<div><br/></div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7114" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7115">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: normal; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-transform: none;">We present our cash and
        short-term investments at estimated fair value. The carrying values in our balance sheet for premium receivables, reinsurance receivables related to paid losses and loss expenses and reinsurance balances payable approximate their fair values. The
        carrying amounts reported in the balance sheet for our borrowings under lines of credit approximate their fair values. We classify these items as Level 3.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7115" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7116">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7116" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7117">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">We evaluate our assets and liabilities on a regular basis to determine the appropriate level at which to classify them for each reporting period. Based on our review of
        the methodology and summary of inputs the pricing services use, we have concluded that our Level 1 and Level 2 investments were classified properly at December 31, 2024 and 2023.</div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7117" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7118">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>

      <ix:nonNumeric name="us-gaap:ScheduleOfFairValueAssetsAndLiabilitiesMeasuredOnRecurringBasisTableTextBlock" id="Text_905ecd2af82c4237a6eaf4cefe66ca91" contextRef="c20240101to20241231" escape="true" continuedAt="Text_8ce6b6b75724468bb5fb75da905dd19b1"><ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7118" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7119">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The following table presents our fair value measurements for our investments in available-for-sale fixed maturity and equity securities at December 31, 2024:</div>
</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_8ce6b6b75724468bb5fb75da905dd19b1" continuedAt="Text_8ce6b6b75724468bb5fb75da905dd19b2"><ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7119" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7120">
<div><br/></div>
</ix:continuation></ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_8ce6b6b75724468bb5fb75da905dd19b2" continuedAt="Text_8ce6b6b75724468bb5fb75da905dd19b3"><ix:continuation id="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7120" continuedAt="Text_7feff4e9e4f34b05911881bf7e72cf7121">
<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" class="cfttable" style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: left; color: #000000; width: 100%; border-spacing: 0;">


  <tr>

    <td valign="bottom" style="vertical-align: bottom; padding-bottom: 2px;"> </td>

    <td valign="bottom" colspan="1" style="vertical-align: bottom; padding-bottom: 2px;"> </td>

    <td valign="bottom" colspan="14" style="vertical-align: bottom; border-bottom: #000000 solid 2px;">
              <div style="text-align: center; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">Fair Value Measurements Using</div>
            </td>

    <td valign="bottom" colspan="1" style="text-align: left; vertical-align: bottom; padding-bottom: 2px; white-space: nowrap;"> </td>

  </tr>

  <tr>

    <td valign="bottom" style="vertical-align: bottom; padding-bottom: 2px;"> </td>

    <td valign="bottom" colspan="1" style="vertical-align: bottom; padding-bottom: 2px; white-space: nowrap;"> </td>

    <td valign="bottom" colspan="2" style="vertical-align: bottom; border-bottom: #000000 solid 2px; white-space: nowrap;">

<div style="font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">8 - Liability for Losses and Loss Expenses</div>
</ix:nonNumeric>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_59da4abd246b493f9ef785d34bc74ea41" continuedAt="Text_59da4abd246b493f9ef785d34bc74ea42">
<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;"><br/>
      </div>
</ix:continuation>
      <ix:continuation id="Text_59da4abd246b493f9ef785d34bc74ea42" continuedAt="Text_59da4abd246b493f9ef785d34bc74ea43">
<div style="display:none;"><br/></div>
<div style="text-indent: 18pt; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; font-size: 10pt;">The establishment of an appropriate liability for losses and loss expenses is an inherently uncertain process, and we can provide no assurance that our insurance
        subsidiaries’ ultimate liability will not exceed their loss and loss expense reserves and have an adverse effect on our results of operations and financial condition. For example, legislative, judicial and regulatory actions may expand coverage
        definitions, retroactively mandate coverage or otherwise require our insurance subsidiaries to pay losses for damages that their policies explicitly excluded or did not intend to cover. Furthermore, we cannot predict the timing, frequency and
        extent of adjustments to our insurance subsidiaries’ estimated future liabilities, because the historical conditions and events that serve as a basis for our insurance subsidiaries’ estimates of ultimate claim costs may change. As is the case for
        substantially all property and casualty insurance companies, our insurance subsidiaries have found it necessary in the past to increase their estimated future liabilities for losses and loss expenses in certain periods, and, in other periods, their
        estimates have exceeded their actual liabilities. Changes in our insurance subsidiaries’ estimate of their liability for losses and loss expenses generally reflect actual payments and their evaluation of information received since the prior
        reporting date.</div>
</ix:continuation>
